affiliation.zh: 北京大学 · 博士研究生

bio.en: I am a Ph.D. student in the School of Intelligence Science and Technology at Peking University, advised by Xiaoru Yuan. My research focuses on visualization and visual analytics, particularly for historical documents and cultural heritage.
bio.zh: 我是北京大学智能学院的博士研究生，导师为袁晓如研究员，研究方向为可视化与可视分析。我主要关注历史文献与文化遗产中的比较、对读和关系探索。

research.en: My current projects include comparing different versions of stone rubbings and reading epitaphs alongside historical texts. I also build practical tools, including a viewer for parallel conference schedules.
research.zh: 近期的项目包括碑刻拓片版本比较，以及墓志与传世史料对读。我也开发一些实用工具，例如用于浏览并行议程的会议日程查看器。
